title: FP8 profile enablement: safety thresholds & cross-batch calibration pipeline
creator: Priya Nair
description: Enable FP8 inference profiles for Hopper-class GPUs with robust E4M3/E5M2 selection, automated cross-batch calibration, and accuracy validation. Goals: (1) make a reproducible calibration pipeline that aggregates per-layer statistics across representative batches, (2) implement safety thresholds and rollback/fallback logic to INT8 for unstable layers, (3) add CI gates and nightly validation dashboards to catch regressions, and (4) provide an operational rollout plan for Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments. Deliverables: calibration service + artifacts, runtime selector logic for E4M3 vs E5M2, fallback policy, CI tests, perf/accuracy dashboard, runbook for on-call.
comments: 2026-02-28 Priya Nair: Created ticket after spike; initial calibration harness prototype collected per-tensor min/max and second-moment stats over 128 batches for BERT-like and decoder transformer workloads. Observed jitter in per-layer scale for attention q/k/v projections when batches include long-tail token sequences.

2026-03-02 Ethan Zhao: Implemented cross-batch aggregator that computes trimmed-mean of scale factors and an inter-batch variance metric. Early results: trimmed-mean stabilizes scales for >80% of layers; 12% of layers still show high variance (ratio > 1.3) between batches.

2026-03-04 Sofia Martinez (Review): Design note — add a layer-level stability score and require stability_score >= 0.7 to pick E4M3; otherwise prefer E5M2 or INT8 fallback. Also recommend storing calibration artifacts with metadata (dataset id, seed, batch-sample ids) for auditability.

2026-03-05 Ethan Zhao: Added safety thresholds: max_inter_batch_variance=1.2, stability_score_threshold=0.7, per-layer rollup. Implemented fallback policy: if layer unstable -> mark for E5M2; if >10% layers unstable or model-level accuracy drop >0.6% -> reject FP8 profile and use INT8 profile.

2026-03-06 QA: Ran evaluation harness on translation and summarization suites. Accuracy (BLEU/ROUGE): within 0.4% of baseline for models with <8% unstable layers; models with unstable layers >12% had regressions up to 1.2%. Added a mitigation path to re-run calibration with localized per-layer quantization parameters and per-channel scaling.

2026-03-08 Engineering Sync: Decision to expose two selection strategies: conservative (prefer E5M2, aggressive safety thresholds) for Hosted/Private default; aggressive (prefer E4M3 when stability_score >= 0.7) option behind runtime flag for Dedicated customers. Need to capture telemetry for flags to monitor real-world error rates.

2026-03-09 Ethan Zhao: Landed initial runtime selector patch that consults calibration artifact and stability scores; added short-circuit that forces INT8 if model-level quality metric delta > 0.6% on the validation set recorded in artifact metadata. Open PR linked in attachments.

2026-03-11 Reliability: Added CI job 'calib-nightly/fp8-validate' to run a small validation suite on representative models (bert-base, gpt-small, t5-small) across Hopper E4M3/E5M2 kernels. CI fails if any model shows >0.75% perplexity increase or >1.0% task metric degradation. First nightly run passed for bert/gpt, t5 reported 0.9% regression (investigating).

2026-03-12 Ethan Zhao: Investigation note — T5 regression traced to layer-norm quantization sensitivity on decoder cross-attention output. Short-term mitigation: pin E5M2 for that layer family; longer-term: add per-op per-channel calibration and test micro-kernel rounding configuration.

2026-03-12 PM Review (Liam O'Connor): Roadmap sign-off to include this feature in runtime-1.19 beta for Dedicated customers with opt-in flag. Need runbook and customer communication for staged rollout; recommend a canary at 5% traffic and automated rollback if error rate or accuracy delta threshold breached.

2026-03-12 Action Items: 1) finish per-channel calibration work (Ethan) 2) expand nightly validation models to include two production customer models (privacy-reviewed) (Solutions Eng) 3) author runbook and rollout playbook (Reliability) 4) add telemetry events for stability_score and per-layer fallback counts (Infra)
2026-03-12 Next Steps: target PR for per-channel calibration by 2026-03-17, CI extension merged by 2026-03-18, runtime-1.19 beta branch cut after validation window.
